name: tactical-survival-stylized
summary: Stylized low-poly tactical survival asset with isometric-friendly proportions, a hand-painted surface, subtle PBR response, a strong readable silhouette, slightly exaggerated believable proportions, and clean real-time geometry.

texture_suffix: Seamless tileable game texture, orthographic flat surface filling the entire frame, no object, no horizon, no perspective, consistent texel density. If an example image shows thin seams, redraw them as those thick bands. Never copy hairline cracks, caulk lines, or pencil seams.
prop_suffix: One game prop centered in frame, three-quarter view, full object visible, neutral flat background, no ground plane, no cast text.
character_suffix: One full-body stylized humanoid, A-pose, feet and hands visible, front three-quarter view, neutral flat background, face toward camera, tactical survival clothing.
building_suffix: Modular architectural piece, orthographic, grid-aligned, neutral background, no extra props.
